parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall orange metal shelves filled with red plastic bins and some yellow boxes. The floor is gray concrete. In the background, workers are near a forklift and stacked cardboard boxes. Lighting comes from overhead fixtures. The camera's motion causes blur on the right side of the image.

objects.label: orange metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered shelves running along the right side of the frame. They hold numerous red bins and some yellow boxes. The shelves appear to be bolted to the floor and wall. Blurred due to camera motion.

objects.label: red plastic bins
objects.observation: Stacked in rows on the shelves. Some have white labels. Many are empty, others contain indistinct items. Located primarily on the lower and middle shelves of the shelving unit. Blurred by motion.

objects.label: yellow cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Placed on upper shelves among red bins. Some are stacked, others sit individually. Visible on multiple levels of the shelving unit. Not blurred as much as the bins.

objects.label: gray concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth, flat surface extending across the entire foreground and midground. Shows some minor scuff marks. Provides base support for all objects above it. Appears clean and uncluttered except for shadows from shelves.

objects.label: workers and forklift
objects.observation: In the background, two people are visible near a forklift. One person stands, the other sits on a stool. The forklift is parked near stacked cardboard boxes. The area is lit by overhead lights. The subjects are out of focus.
